column2: HPLC parameters set using a reverse-phase C18 column, a water–organic solvent mobile phase, 10 µL injection volume, 30 °C column temperature, 1.0 mL min−1 flow rate, and UV detection at 273 nm.
Reverse-phase C18 column, commonly 250 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm or 150 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm
Water:acetonitrile, commonly 80:20 or 70:30 v/v; may include 0.1% formic/acetic acid
5–15 min per sample; caffeine peak often around 3–8 min, depending on column/mobile phase
UV/PDA detection commonly at 272–280 nm; caffeine monitored at 273 nm
